title: Ferry first 1:1 tile USGS 3DEP terrain elevation source authorization

sourceRaster.sampleMethod: A provisional package must record the exact source-raster SHA-256, integer native pixel window, compressed source tile indices and bytes read, deterministic sample computation, serialized sample-window SHA-256, and per-feature evidence SHA-256.

permitted: sample bare-earth terrain elevations for otherwise 2D geometry as source-declared-navd88-unrealized values
create a provisional elevation artifact with reproducible source-window evidence
prohibited: claiming that the geometry source itself is natively NAVD88
claiming sampled elevations are realized NAVD88 or vertically production-certified
claiming a built terrain artifact, runtime integration, manifest promotion, or a fully production 1:1 tile

evidence.limitation: The dependent raw lock records no vertical GeoKeys and states that geoid and epoch are not locked. This authorization therefore preserves only the source product metadata declaration as source-declared-navd88-unrealized. It does not establish a NAVD88 realization, geoid, coordinate epoch, production terrain artifact, vertical-production certification, or fully production 1:1 tile.
